Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on run: prompt routing, surge load, and success criteria

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Nebula would like to move to a short hands-on POC so we can validate prompt flow and routing behavior under a simulated surge. High-level goals:
- Review our prompt set (intent coverage + edge cases)
- Validate routing policies (latency vs cost lanes) with live routing toggles
- Run a 15–20 minute surge load test to observe autoscaling and KV caching behavior

Proposed week: Apr 20–24 (we're flexible on the day). Attendees from our side: Leah Soto (PM), Ravi Singh (Infra). Can you include the SRE and solutions engineer leads from Redwood?

Pre-reqs we can prepare: prompt corpus, sample traffic mix, service account for auth.

Thanks — Leah

Karthik / Leah — late window (Thu 17:30–19:30) is fine from infra perspective, we just need to lock the surge parameters ahead of time. Quick notes:
- Prefer a 20-minute dedicated surge at the end (not interleaved) to limit noise when measuring autoscale.
- Suggested starting point: 500 concurrent users simulated, 75% short-context (<=128 tokens), 25% long-context (>=1024 tokens).
- We'll need a single service account from Nebula with token creation rights at least 48h before the run.

Attached: load-parameters.csv with the baseline I mentioned. Also: Ben will be on the session to watch metrics, Monica will lead prompt review.

Ben

Date: 2026-04-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC hands-on — Apr 23 recap & owners (action log)

Team — great session last night. Quick recap and agreed actions (owners / due dates):

Recap:
- Prompt issues: handled three edge cases (ambiguous user intents) by adding disambiguation prompts and low-confidence fallbacks.
- Routing: toggled cost lane and observed ~12% latency increase under cost-saver mode; caching reduced token spend on repeated prefixes by ~18%.
- Surge run: autoscaled as expected; transient 15s warm-up period before peak throughput. No errors above 5xx threshold.

Action items:
- Monica: update prompt bundle with disambiguation snippets and upload prompt-bundle-v2.json to Drive. Due: 2026-04-26.
- Ben: iterate on load parameters to reduce warm-up oscillation (tweak prefetch/batch sizing). Share updated load-parameters.csv. Due: 2026-04-28.
- DAVID KIM: produce a short success-metrics doc (latency P95, token cost delta, cache hit-rate) and attach to deal record. Due: 2026-04-27.
- Leah / Ravi (Nebula): provide final sample traffic set (anonymized) and grant service account token by Apr 21 (if not already). Outstanding.
- Karthik: schedule follow-up session (deep dive on cost-optimizations + rollout plan). Proposed dates in Doodle (link above). Tentative target week: May 11–15.

Notes / links: prompt-bundle-v1.json (pre-read), final-agenda.pdf, runbook-checklist.xlsx attached earlier. HubSpot deal: https://app.redwood.com/deals/NEB-2026-001

If I've missed anything please flag — I'll track these in the deal plan and loop CS for renewal touchpoints.

Best,
